mapper.select: SELECT shadow.tenant_id, shadow.device_id, shadow.shadow_version, shadow.reported_state::text AS state_json, shadow.reported_at, shadow.received_at, shadow.applied_desired_version, shadow.projection_version, organization.path AS organization_path FROM device_shadow_projection shadow JOIN device ON device.id = shadow.device_id AND device.tenant_id = shadow.tenant_id JOIN organization ON organization.id = device.organization_id AND organization.tenant_id = device.tenant_id WHERE shadow.device_id = #{deviceId}

SELECT tenant_id, device_id, shadow_version, reported_state::text AS state_json, reported_at, received_at, applied_desired_version, projection_version, NULL::text AS organization_path FROM device_shadow_projection WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_shadow_projection(tenant_id, device_id, shadow_version, reported_state, reported_at, received_at, applied_desired_version, projection_version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{deviceId}, #{shadowVersion}, CAST(#{stateJson} AS jsonb), #{reportedAt}, #{receivedAt}, #{appliedDesiredVersion}, #{projectionVersion})
INSERT INTO device_shadow_inbox(tenant_id, event_id, device_id, received_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{eventId}, #{deviceId}, #{receivedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, event_id) DO NOTHING
